# proxmox_user (Data Source)

Fetches details of a single Proxmox VE user from `/access/users/{userid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_user" "admin" {
  user_id = "admin@pam"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Full User ID in `name@realm` format.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `expire` (Number)
- `firstname` (String)
- `groups` (String)
- `id` (String) User identifier.
- `lastname` (String)
